title: Rider Arrival Payload (v1.0.0)
description: A rider arrives at a stop to wait for a bus. When origin is 'train', train_trip_id is required and identifies the Metro train the rider arrived on.

stop_id.description: Stop where the rider is waiting.

direction.description: Travel direction. Turn 1 supports direction 1 only.

origin.description: Origin of the rider. 'train' means arrival from a Metro train (requires train_trip_id).

destination_stop_id.description: Stop the rider wants to travel to.

train_trip_id.description: Metro train trip identifier. Required when origin is 'train'; forbidden otherwise.
